name: Low-level concurrent and parallel functional programming language

mentions.name: Low-level concurrent and parallel functional programming language
mentions.description: A low-level concurrent and parallel functional programming language with very non-traditional syntax and a modal, dependent type theory. The builder is preparing its initial release with a basic project website, demos of the core language features, development streams covering a compiler reimplementation, and a Rocq implementation of the language's syntax and semantics for proof work, using streaming to explore the language's niche and draw interest.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on finally releasing the programming language I’ve been working on for quite a while.

I’m setting up the basic site, which is not a huge deal, but I’ve been inspired by more recent language designers having a streaming presence, so I am working through test runs of streaming my development.

I hope to start with demos of the basic language features and then move on to streaming both a reimplementation of my compiler and on a Rocq implementation of the syntax and semantics of the language for proof work.
